about_us_page.title: A workspace built with love
about_us_page.subtitle: Not an office. Not a café. A small, hand-crafted home in Tallinn for people who take their work seriously - and their comfort even more seriously.
about_us_page.story_text: We were tired of two things: cold corporate offices that drain you by Wednesday, and working from home alone with the dishes calling from the next room. So we built the place we wanted to spend our own days in - small enough that you know everyone's name by your second visit, quiet enough that you can actually think, and warm enough that you don't want to leave when the workday ends.
about_us_page.craft_title: Built with love, not by a chain
about_us_page.craft_text: Every detail in this space was chosen by us, not by a procurement department. We picked the chairs because we tested them with our own backs (IKEA Markus - best in its class for an 8-hour day). We rotate the coffee monthly through local Tallinn roasters because flat office coffee makes flat workdays. The lighting is warm because fluorescent strips give us headaches. The plants are real because plastic ones feel like a lie. The Wi-Fi is fiber-optic because nothing kills focus like a spinning loader. None of this was the cheapest option - it was the right one.
about_us_page.community_text: We deliberately keep the space small. Six to ten people on a typical day means you actually meet your coworkers - designers, developers, writers, language teachers, founders. People who started with a one-day trial and stayed for years. That's the test we care about most: would you want to come back tomorrow?
about_us_page.mission_text: To prove that a workspace can be more than rented square meters. That craft, care, and a small group of good people can turn an ordinary weekday into something you actually look forward to. We're building the Tallinn workspace we wished existed - and inviting you to make it yours too.
about_us_page.boardgames_note_title: And yes - there are board games
about_us_page.boardgames_note_text: After hours and on weekends, the space transforms. We're board game enthusiasts ourselves and have built up a collection of over 1,000 titles. But during the workday this is a coworking space first - the games stay on the shelf until 18:00.
about_us_page.invitation_title: Come spend a day with us
about_us_page.invitation_text: Your first day is on us. Bring your laptop, bring whatever you're working on, and see whether this is the place where your best work happens.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.content:
# Do I need a membership to work here?
You can use day passes or choose a monthly membership.

# What are your opening hours?
Monthly Members: 24/7
Day Pass Users: Monday to Friday: 9:00-18:00

# How do I get access after hours?
Via personal key card / code.

# Can I bring guests?
Yes, guests are allowed for a limited time and must be registered.

# Is high-speed internet included?
Yes, enterprise-grade Wi-Fi. Optic fiber connection.

# What membership plans do you offer?
Daily, weekly, monthly, and team plans.

# What is included in the membership?
Workspace, internet, utilities, coffee/tea, cleaning, community events.

# Are there long-term discounts?
Yes, for 3-month, 6-month, and annual plans can be discussed.

# Is the space pet-friendly?
Small, well-behaved pets are allowed. Please inform us in advance.

# What is your cancellation policy?
14-day notice for monthly plans

# Can I use the address for company registration?
Yes, virtual office and legal address services are available.

# Is the space secure?
24/7 CCTV, access control, and personal lockers (coming soon).

# Can I try the space before committing?
Yes, with a free tour or trial day.

# Where are you located and how do I get there?
We are located at Kivimurru 34. Easily accessible by public transport and bike. Not far from T1 center.
